content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to obtain a license for [product_name] directly online from [company_name], rather than waiting weeks for shipment via a distributor? If there's an online purchase option, please let me know so I can avoid a 4-5 week delay. Thank you, [user_name].

Hi, Where do you live that it takes 4 weeks for a [company_name] representative to send a CD? When I order, I typically receive it by the following Tuesday. As far as I know, the license is provided on the CD and isn't downloadable. To check for faster options, contact your local [company_name] representative. You can find their contact information at 'Contacts Worldwide' on this page. Regards, [user_name]

Hi, I'm in a developing country where service is challenging. Other German companies deliver in just a few days, but with [company_name], we still need to register and wait several days, and it's hard just to find the right contact for a small purchase. Second question: does [product_name] version 8 still use [product_name] Soft Comfort, or will there be some kind of portal extension instead? Thank you, [user_name]

Hi, It sounds like [company_name] has room to improve customer support in your region. No offense—just interested. You could try downloading the demo version to develop and test your work in simulation while waiting for the full product. You just can't transfer programs to the device with the demo. I think [product_name] version 8 will use [product_name] Soft Comfort 8, not as an add-on to another portal system. Regards, [user_name]

No offense taken. That's exactly what I'm doing. The issue is I've completed the software, but now I need to install it on the hardware. The finance team only just requested the funds for the license now. Thanks again! I'll likely have more questions in the future. [user_name]
Hello, Have you considered trying Amazon or RS Components?
I checked Amazon, but there are no CDs available. I will try RS Components next. Thanks, [user_name]

[user_name], just for reference: I spoke with [company_name] locally and was informed it typically takes around 3 weeks to get the product. Something about processing the order in Germany, then shipping time, and some extra delays once here. Thanks again to everyone.

I understand your frustration—engineering often requires as much dealing with people as working with technology. Speak directly with your [company_name] contact. This delay isn't your fault or theirs, but if they're motivated, maybe they can help—possibly offer you a loan or assist with loading the controller for you. You don't need to promise huge purchases, just place your order and discuss your situation—they may be able to help make you a regular satisfied customer. You might mention you're already impressed with the helpful forum support. Good luck! [user_name]

Thank you for your advice. They offered to loan me a license while waiting for the CD, provided we show proof we've ordered and are paying for it. The support here on the forum is excellent—thanks to everyone! Goodbye for now, [user_name]
Glad to hear the good outcome! Thank you for the feedback. [user_name]

Hello, You think 4 weeks is long? In my country, it works like this: You need to order through a system integrator since [company_name] won't accept direct orders. The integrator takes about a week to process the order through the regional office. The regional office then books it in SAP, which is another week. All SAP orders are gathered and submitted to head office in Germany (typically weekly or biweekly). Then all orders are shipped from Germany to the head office (usually within a week). From the head office, orders are sorted and couriered to customers (another week). In summary, the process can take six weeks—and that's if you're lucky. Clearly, the whole system needs major improvement. Cheers

Hello, Definitely, there's a lot of work to be done in some places. Our main supplier usually has most parts in stock, and delivery is only two days. Special or expensive items must be ordered from [company_name] and take up to two weeks at most. During urgent production downtime, we can get needed parts within a day—at a premium price. For software, it should be possible to pay and download directly unless regulation issues are an obstacle. Regards,

I agree—a download option should be available. Many older software products can be downloaded using an AVC card. A similar download/pay system could be made available for most software, provided there are no hardware dongle restrictions. Cheers

analysis.insight_summary: Users from certain regions report that acquiring a license for [product_name] Soft Comfort is slow, often taking several weeks due to local distribution and representation procedures from [company_name]. Since licenses are distributed on physical media and not available as digital downloads, the process is frustrating, especially when local support is inefficient. Alternate channels and customer service interactions are also described as complicated and time-consuming.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to access licenses quickly and easily through online channels rather than facing long shipping delays. They want prompt support and simple, transparent purchasing options locally.
